name: jstack-subagents
description: Top-level JStack command that prompt-compiles intent before deploying the right specialist team.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy the right team, normally two or three specialists
interface.longDescription: Top-level Codex command for JStack specialist-team mode. An inspect-first Adaptive Context Gate resolves material requirements before dispatch, asking at most three questions with recommended defaults. The right subagent team then uses deterministic capability routing, launch evidence, structured results, privacy-safe telemetry, and signed handoff validation under Lead Engineer accountability.
defaultPrompt: Deploy the right JStack specialist team.
